# Amazon Redshift runtime and snapshots

**Status: proposed.** This service or extension is not implemented in the registered API profiles.
The scope below is a design candidate, without an assigned version or delivery date.

## First useful slice

Extend the records-only control plane with explicit runtime and snapshot support.

## Proposed scope

- [ ] SQL warehouse runtime and JDBC/ODBC execution
- [ ] Snapshot create/list/delete/restore and final snapshots
- [ ] Pause/resume/reboot/resize lifecycle
- [ ] Parameter values and application
